items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Bennie Carter had came to take Don Redman's place... I stayed with that band from December 7, 1930, to about May 1932.

ctx.x: And when I made that record at that time, too, Bennie Carter had came to take Don Redman's place because Don had left to get his own band.
Who were all the guys in that band -- this, again, I'm trying to recapture this band of McKinney's -- when you joined it?
